idea-plugin.name: 1337 Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A dark theme and editor color scheme for IntelliJ Platform IDEs, based on the original Sublime Text 1337 Scheme.

Includes coordinated editor, syntax, VCS, diff, scrollbar, and IDE UI colors. Supports IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, CLion, RubyMine, DataGrip, RustRover, and Rider on platform build 262 (2026.2) or newer.

After installation, select 1337 Theme in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance. The matching editor scheme is also available in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme.

Based on 1337 Scheme by Mark Herpich. Report an issue.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: dark UI and editor colors for IntelliJ Platform IDEs, including syntax highlighting, VCS statuses, diff colors, editor scrollbars, and additional Rider semantic colors.
